comparison.objective: Replace a cabin air filter behind a glove box; unlike screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Deflect glove-box walls past stops, extract/insert a filter, and restore the assembly without breakage.
comparison.success_condition: New filter must be correctly installed after safe glove-box opening, old filter removed, and components restored; no material rubric detail is missing across versions.
comparison.reason: Tests access-panel manipulation and constrained filter replacement.
